name: bow_self_stave
what: a long self bow: a tall slender stave, Lying corner to corner: the stave curves in a smooth bow from the bottom-left corner round the upper left to the top-right corner, the bowstring a straight thin pale cream line from tip to tip facing the lower right, the grip wrapped in red-brown leather at the middle of the stave, small horn-coloured tips. Warm orange-brown oak wood with clear grain; the string clearly paler than the wood. 1-2 px margin

name: bow_short_stave
what: a short bow: a shorter, more strongly curved stave that fills about three quarters of the diagonal, Lying corner to corner: the stave curves in a smooth bow from the bottom-left corner round the upper left to the top-right corner, the bowstring a straight thin pale cream line from tip to tip facing the lower right, the grip wrapped in red-brown leather at the middle of the stave, small horn-coloured tips. Warm orange-brown oak wood with clear grain; the string clearly paler than the wood. 1-2 px margin
